cases.why: og:image becomes a relative path, which the page itself would resolve but link-preview crawlers do not, so every shared link shows no image.
the description grows past what a search result shows, so the sentence is cut mid-clause in every result.
cases.find: <meta name="description" content="Weekly NFL picks from two models, one football-only and one with the Vegas spread, graded in public, with every experiment logged, failures included.">
cases.replace: <meta name="description" content="Weekly NFL picks from two models, one football-only and one with the Vegas spread, graded in public every Tuesday, with every experiment logged, failures included, and every claim checked by a second agent.">

cases.why: the preview's description is edited and the search one is not, so the site describes itself two ways depending on where you meet it.
cases.find: <meta property="og:description" content="Weekly NFL picks from two models, one football-only and one with the Vegas spread, graded in public, with every experiment logged, failures included.">

cases.why: the declared size stops matching the file, so a crawler that trusts the tags lays out the preview for the wrong shape.
